candidates.name: White Cable Turtleneck
candidates.decisionReason: The isolated product image provides no shoulder, torso or sleeve proof, while the slim cable layout reads traditional and risks a fitted dated office silhouette.

candidates.name: Light-Green Long-Sleeve Polo
candidates.decisionReason: The green is welcome, but full-resolution review shows heavily dropped shoulders, washed sweatshirt fabric, long sleeves and a rounded untucked hem that read Casual rather than polished Office.

candidates.name: Brown Long-Sleeve Knit Polo
candidates.decisionReason: The controlled boxy knit is wearable, but its very dark brown would combine with the planned camel coat into the muddy brown-heavy palette this rebuild is removing.

candidates.name: Beige Turtleneck
candidates.decisionReason: The product-only image does not prove body ease, and beige under a camel coat with a khaki trouser would create a washed-out all-neutral outfit without the requested happier color.

candidates.name: Coffee Textured Button-Neck Knit
candidates.decisionReason: The dropped shoulder, fuzzy oversized body and obstructing backpack strap weaken fit proof, while coffee brown repeats the planned camel outerwear instead of adding color.

candidates.name: Dark-Green Argyle Knit
candidates.decisionReason: The red and green argyle adds color, but the full-resolution body is extremely dropped, long and voluminous; it would bunch under a coat and recreate the oversized-top imbalance.

candidates.name: Mustard Clean Half-Zip
candidates.decisionReason: Mustard is useful, but the narrow torso, tight sleeves and technical half-zip construction reproduce the skinny sporty top problem rather than modern Winter Office knitwear.

candidates.name: Brown Double-Pleat Trouser
candidates.decisionReason: The full worn source proves a clean high rise, restrained double pleat, controlled thigh ease, pressed straight-to-tapered leg and full hem. It passes only with the soft-blue, camel, burgundy and winter-cream balance defined for this direction.

candidates.name: Light-Gray Relaxed Trouser
candidates.decisionReason: The floating product image omits rise, seat, full hem and on-body drape, so the apparently cropped light trouser cannot support an Office approval.

candidates.name: Khaki Relaxed Trouser
candidates.decisionReason: The full worn image contradicts the relaxed product label: the trouser clings through the thigh, narrows sharply below the knee and reads like a dated skinny office pant. It cannot remain a hold under the no-skinny silhouette rule.

candidates.name: Army-Green Pleated Corduroy Trouser
candidates.decisionReason: The product-only image shows a very broad corduroy leg collapsing and stacking at the hem, with no trustworthy on-body Office fit proof.

candidates.name: Camel Relaxed-Straight Trouser
candidates.decisionReason: The low casual rise, broad leg and heavy sneaker-level stacking create the baggy bottom problem, and camel would duplicate the planned coat.

candidates.name: Khaki Regular Straight Trouser
candidates.decisionReason: It is clean but visibly narrower and more conventional through the thigh and ankle, making it less modern and less balanced than B3.
